quests.title: Nahuatzin's Leap

dialogue.t: Chosen of Dragons, O Chosen of Dragons...
Ascend to the circlet's highest pinnacle — then hurl yourself into the Sacred Mountain's fire!
Go forth and reveal it — break the golden seal, unveil the radiance of remnant flames unnumbered!
Rrroar...
What's wrong? Did you see a bunch of strange words again?

dialogue.sit: It feels like... we're getting closer...

dialogue.t: Oh, you mean it's because we're getting closer to the volcano?
Rawr!
...It's almost as if the person who's been talking to you all this time is in that mountain.
Anyway, since those things are showing up as we're getting closer to the volcano, that's gotta mean we're on the right track.
Rawr!
Phew. We finally made it. Paimon didn't think it'd be so high up... but at least it's not as cold as Paimon thought it would be.
Grroah, rrohh, rowrr!
Uh-huh, says the meaty guy with the thick skin!
That's gotta be the volcano's mouth, right? What a view...
Hmm... When we asked for directions earlier, weren't we told that there's a ton of gaseous phlogiston in the volcano's mouth?
Looks like we need to find a way down.
Hmm, speaking of which, what's that? It looks like... some kinda strange statue.
Oh! Could this statue be the one that Kimosi said a Qucusaurus stole?
Rawr!
Phew. We're finally up here. Paimon didn't think it'd be so high up... but at the same time, it's not as cold as Paimon thought.
Grroah, rrohh, rowrr!
Uh-huh, says the meaty guy with the thick skin!
That's gotta be the volcano's mouth, right? What a view...
Hmm... When we asked for directions earlier, weren't we told that there's a ton of gaseous phlogiston in the volcano's mouth?
Looks like we need to find a way down.
Hmm, speaking of which, what's that? It looks like... some strange statue.
Rawr!
Huh? Was that... a Qucusaur? So, Qucusaurs really do bring the stolen statues here...
Wait. Did it just grab that statue and jump... straight into the crater!?
That's gotta be the volcano's mouth, right? What a view...
Hmm... When we asked for directions earlier, weren't we told that there's a ton of gaseous phlogiston in the volcano's mouth?
Oh wait, that's right! We can <color=#00E1FFFF>find a way to pass through gaseous phlogiston</color>, just like that Qucusaur did!
But, uh... *gulp* Kinda high up, aren't we?

dialogue.sit: Don't worry, Paimon, I'll carry you.
As long as you grab me just as we land...

dialogue.t: Rawr!
Err, you're all set to take the plunge too? Well... Um, alright. I—If that's the case, Paimon's not that scared anymore either.
And it's not just that we're high up — don't forget about the gaseous phlogiston!
A—Anyway, let's make sure we're all set before we go!
Huh? Was that a Q—Qucusaur?
Did it just grab that statue and jump... straight into the crater!?
That's gotta be the volcano's mouth, right? What a view...
Hmm... When we asked for directions earlier, weren't we told that there's a ton of gaseous phlogiston in the volcano's mouth?
Oh wait, that's right! We can <color=#00E1FFFF>find a way to pass through gaseous phlogiston</color>, just like the Qucusaurus from back there!
But, uh... *gulp* Kinda high up, aren't we?

dialogue.sit: Don't you worry, Paimon, I'll carry you.
As long as you grab me just as we land...

dialogue.t: Rawr!
Err, you wanna go in too? Well... Ugh, alright. I—If that's the case, Paimon's not that scared anymore.
And it's not just that we're high up — don't forget about the gaseous phlogiston!
A—Anyway, let's make sure we're all set before we go!

quests.description: Find a way to enter the volcano…
